# Sunrise Natural Stones

> Sunrise Natural Stones (also trading as Sunrise Marbles and Granites) is a natural stone exporter based in Udaipur, Rajasthan, India, exporting for more than 25 years. We supply Indian marble, granite, sandstone and quartz as blocks, slabs and cut-to-size products, and carve single-block marble bathtubs, sinks and basins. We sell B2B to importers, fabricators, builders, architects and interior designers in the USA, UK, Europe, Australia, New Zealand and the Middle East.

Contact: contact@sunrisenaturalstones.com, +91 94141 65502, WhatsApp +91 70145 68709.
Address: Block-A, Pratap Nagar C, 96-98, Near Nagda Petrol Pump, Pratap Nagar, Udaipur, Rajasthan 313001, India.
Export ports: Mundra and Kandla, Gujarat. Terms: FOB, CFR, CIF. Packing: ISPM-15 fumigated crates and A-frames.
Credentials: FIEO (Federation of Indian Export Organisations) member.

## Products

- [Marble slabs](https://www.sunrisenaturalstones.com/marble-slabs): Nirzerna white, Aagaria, Indian onyx, Indian green (Verde Guatemala) and Panda White marble, 18/20/30 mm, polished, honed or leathered.
- [Granite slabs](https://www.sunrisenaturalstones.com/granite-slabs): Devgarh black, Sirohi P white, Alaska white, Alaska gold, Alaska azul and Blue Dunes granite, 2 cm and 3 cm.
- [Marble blocks](https://www.sunrisenaturalstones.com/marble-blocks): raw quarry blocks for processors, priced per cubic metre with six-face photos.
- [Granite blocks](https://www.sunrisenaturalstones.com/granite-blocks): rough and dressed blocks for gangsaw and block-cutter processing.
- [Solid marble bathtubs](https://www.sunrisenaturalstones.com/stone-bathtubs): freestanding tubs carved from a single block of marble or granite, made to designers' drawings for luxury residences and hotels.
- [Granite countertops](https://www.sunrisenaturalstones.com/granite-countertops): countertops, worktops and benchtops cut to size.
- [Marble sinks and basins](https://www.sunrisenaturalstones.com/luxury-stone-sinks): vessel, undermount and pedestal basins carved from one piece.
- [Vanity tops](https://www.sunrisenaturalstones.com/stone-vanity-tops): marble and granite vanity tops with basin cut-outs.
- [Indian sandstone](https://www.sunrisenaturalstones.com/sandstone-exporters): Bijolia, Dholpur, beige, red and pink sandstone paving and slabs.
- [Gravestones and monuments](https://www.sunrisenaturalstones.com/gravestones-monuments): granite headstones and memorials.
